---
name: New technique or claim
about: Add a technique to the evidence ledger (grade + source required)
title: "[technique] "
labels: new-technique
---

**Technique / claim:**
<!-- One sentence. What does it claim to do? -->

**Proposed grade:** solid / mixed / folklore
<!-- solid = reproducible + sourced; mixed = depends on scope; folklore = no reproducible evidence -->

**Scope:** where it applies — and where it does NOT.

**Primary source(s):**
<!-- Paper (arXiv/DOI), official vendor docs, or a reproducible experiment. No blog-of-a-blog. -->

**Evidence:**
<!-- What does the source actually show? Effect size, task, model, date if measured. -->

**Reproducible?** yes-offline / yes-llm / paper-only / no

---
> Reminder: no grade + no primary source = it doesn't get merged. That rule is the point of this repo.
